edges.subject: NCL causative genes
edges.quote: As a lysosomal storage disease, all 13 of NCL's causative genes affect endolysosomal function, and at least four have been directly linked to retromer.

edges.subject: retromer
edges.quote: A retromer is a multimodular protein assembly critical for sorting and trafficking cargo out of the endosome.

edges.subject: PD causative genes
edges.quote: PD has several known causative genes, with one directly linked to retromer and others causing endolysosomal dysfunction.
